intent: Dropdown for choosing one option from a short fixed list.
useWhen: Five or fewer visible options where a native select is acceptable
Inside Field for labeled form fields
doNotUseWhen: Mutually exclusive choices with visible options — prefer RadioGroup

ariaLabel.note: When there is no Field label, such as a DataTable Cell.

requirements: Must have associated label via Field
Each option needs a human-readable label

doNot: Do not invent local Select or combobox
Do not use for navigation — use AppNav or links
snippet: <Field label="Timezone" htmlFor="tz"><Select id="tz" options={[{ value: 'utc', label: 'UTC' }]} /></Field>
